messages.text: Does the Section 31 20 00 required compaction density for the structural fill under the building pad shown on Grading Plan C-201 hold up against the geotechnical report's requirements for this area? No particular urgency here -- please review at your convenience. No cost impact is expected from this compliance question. This isn't holding up any current earthwork activity. A response within three days would help us stay ahead of the compaction testing.

Detail 6/C-601 directly addresses the Section 31 20 00 required compaction density for the structural fill under the building pad per the geotechnical review; the civil inspector should be able to sign off as documented.
